source_qualification.origin: IRGC Public Relations office, official public assertion distributed through Tasnim
source_qualification.publication_clock: Tasnim displayed 2026-11-04 08:13; timezone not independently specified by source page; do not impute UTC
source_qualification.source_qualification_boundary: Publisher correctly quotes a military operational claim; separate non-Iranian physical evidence of drone downing / four distinct tanker losses is not established by repetition.

cases.actor: IRGC Public Relations office attributing claimed engagement to IRGC Aerospace Force air-defense personnel
propositions: One U.S.-operated MQ-9 Reaper was shot down over the Strait of Hormuz at approximately 04:30 local time on November 4, 2026.
The alleged November 4 aircraft was the 56th U.S. MQ-9 of its model downed by Iranian forces over the conflict.

atomic_truth.gap: No uniquely identified airframe, U.S. inventory confirmation or independently authenticated crash proof
No auditable per-event 1–56 MQ-9 ledger, and potential overlap with November 3/4 Wikipedia claim-only entries

cases.reviewed_truth: UNSUBSTANTIATED; no individual verified November 4 loss or exact 56th cumulative identification
cases.reviewed_knowledge: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; IRGC Aerospace has presumed engagement records but they have not been authenticated or matched against U.S. inventory
cases.required_discriminator: Distinct November 3 vs November 4 US MQ-9 airframe evidence and original IRGC cumulative event log

cases.actor: IRGC Public Relations office attributing tanker action to IRGC Navy
propositions: Four distinct oil tankers were destroyed by naval mines while transiting the prohibited southern Hormuz route.
The four tankers remained burning as of the November 4 military statement.
Each allegedly destroyed tanker was violating an Iranian-designated prohibition on the southern route.

atomic_truth.gap: No four vessel names, IMO numbers or independent destruction proof; mine type not individually established
No independent same-time per-hull heat/fire or operational-state observations
Iran's route designation is an actor claim, not proof of internationally recognized shipping illegality

cases.reviewed_truth: UNSUBSTANTIATED for four distinct mined/destroyed hulls, mechanism, and simultaneous fire status
cases.reviewed_knowledge: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; institutional marine incident/traffic logs may exist but no identified four-hull inventory, corrections or internal speaker-access record yet
cases.required_discriminator: Four separate ship IMO numbers, event times, mine/explosion causation, and distinction from prior stopped/damaged vessels

cases.actor: IRGC Public Relations office attributing maritime interdictions to IRGC Navy
propositions: Two additional vessels were intercepted and halted in the Strait of Hormuz.
Those two vessels were committing alleged route violations.

atomic_truth.gap: No names, IMO identities, port-state or AIS corroboration
No independent verified internationally binding route-prohibition basis

cases.reviewed_truth: UNSUBSTANTIATED for physically stopped vessel identities; must not be added to four tankers destroyed
cases.required_discriminator: Two identifiable vessel movements, captures/interdictions and confirmed subsequent outcomes

corrections.source_speaker: Iranian Navy (regular Navy per contemporaneous independent comparison), NOT independently sourced IRGC Navy
corrections.exact_original_target: enemy unmanned surface vessel, operator NOT named
corrections.media_mutation: Reuters and follow-on U.S. commentary presented U.S. vessel interpretation; this is a distinct attribution/claim-carrier proposition
corrections.official_denial: CENTCOM asserted all U.S. military USVs in the Middle East accounted for; materially contradicts a U.S. military USV loss, not every hypothetical unnamed enemy USV
corrections.truth_knowledge_boundary: Original enemy-USV destruction unsubstantiated, U.S.-operator version officially disputed; no proved original Iranian Navy knowingly falsehood

acceptance: Claims Forensics source review only; does not alter sealed governance, public WOL, lie denominator or prior official outcomes.
